items.q: And 60 other... Glynis Johns, a whole bunch of people.

ctx.x: Isn’t it human nature to create resolution?

Yeah. To create resolution only when you really know the value that exists within that resolution. When you’re creating value... Creating value... The truth means nothing unless the truth can be made...you can make value of the truth. When you know you’re creating value, you will always be greeted with great resistance.
